threats.title: Confidential metrics exposed from the stored database
threats.description: Metrics records associate product accounts with usage counters and are treated as confidential business data. An attacker who obtains the stored data — a stolen disk, a platform-side copy, or a captured connection — would hold confidential business data. The document states the platform encrypts the database at rest by default with platform-managed keys and that the API-to-database connection uses the platform's transport encryption.
preconditions: an attacker obtains stored data or captures the database connection
attack_path: obtain the stored database contents or capture the connection
read account identifiers and usage counters

threats.title: Confidential metrics retained beyond need
threats.description: Metrics are persisted and treated as confidential, but no document states how long they are retained or whether a lifecycle policy expires them. Data kept longer than needed widens the impact of any later disclosure.
preconditions: metrics accumulate without a retention bound
attack_path: any later compromise of the store
read the full accumulated history rather than a bounded window
threats.impact: A disclosure exposes the full accumulated metrics history.
